13.t: To change toggle positions of the switch assembly, you need not remove the game PCB. The switch, usually colored blue, is easily accessible when the game PCB is mounted in place.

When changing the options, verify proper results on the TV monitor display during self-test. A switch toggle in the on position is indicated by a 0 for that switch on the TV monitor display. A switch in the off position is indicated by a 1.
